entities.title: Police Radio Resources
entities.description: A quick listening guide to agency call signs, radio language, officer names, and radio IDs in AFPD recordings.
entities.attributionNote: An officer may have used an ID in these exchanges without being the speaker in every recording under that ID. Attributing a particular statement to an officer still requires further confirmation.

callSigns.title: Agency call signs
callSigns.description: The agency part of a spoken unit identifier tells you which department is calling. J is spoken as “Juliet.” For example, the 5J in 5J171 identifies American Fork; it does not identify the officer by itself.

language.title: Radio language
language.description: Short meanings for terms you may hear. Codes and abbreviations can vary by agency; use the surrounding conversation to interpret them.

entries.example: “10-9, my radio cut out” is a request to hear the message again.
An acknowledgment does not necessarily identify the person being addressed.
A short reply may need the preceding clip to make sense.

entries.meaning: Usually the reporting party: the person who reported the incident.
entries.example: It describes a role in the call, not necessarily a victim or suspect.
“At the PD” commonly means at the police station.
The archive on this site covers AFPD’s car-to-car talkgroup, 6001.

officers.title: Names, nicknames, and radio IDs
officers.description: Look up a name you hear or an ID shown beside a clip. Most listed IDs have named-response examples across multiple days in the selected spreadsheet. Ivan / Bird uses October 24 exchanges and the roster. Choates, Sam / Sammy, and T-Ball / G-Ball include owner listening observations added October 27, documented in their notes. Associations do not identify the speaker in every recording. Jackie / Jaclyn Strong includes owner confirmation for October 4 only. Manis / Dustin includes owner confirmation for October 4 only.
officers.coverage: September 9–October 22, 2026; Ivan / Bird added October 24; Choates, Sam, and Ballamis observations added October 27, 2026; Jackie / Strong confirmed for October 4 by owner review on October 27; Manis confirmed for October 4 by owner review on October 28

entries.name: Ivan R. Bird
entries.note: October 24 clips 18–19 and 43–47 address Ivan and receive replies on 14590165. The officer roster identifies Ivan R. Bird as the matching officer. This ID also appears on October 20 (clips 68 and 70), but those exchanges do not name its speaker. This is a single-day named association; it does not identify every speaker using this radio.

entries.name: Delton L. Choates
entries.note: October 21 clips 33–34, October 24 clips 132–133, and October 25 clips 31–33, 34–35, and 39–40 address Choates and receive replies on 14590313. September 17 clips 254–255 and October 11 clips 259–260 associate 14590045 with replies to the name; those name readings remain uncertain. These exchanges associate radios with Choates but do not identify every speaker using either ID.

entries.name: Greg B. Mecham
entries.note: The surname Mecham and first name Greg are linked through the roster candidate.

entries.name: Jaclyn G. Strong
entries.note: October 4, 2026: owner confirms Jaclyn G. Strong for all 14590104 clips that day. Clip 8 says Jackie? (transcript verified), followed by clip 9 on 14590104. October 3 also has clear Jackie/Jacqueline-addressed replies (transcript evidence). The five selected workbook examples span four dates. Other screened dates use Strong association; October 26 stays ID-only pending review of the ambiguous David? exchange in clips 80–81. Only October 4 has owner audio confirmation.

entries.name: Kelepi Makai
entries.note: Makai is confirmed in the corrected exchanges. The October 1 reply on 14590247 remains unclear. September 12 clips 446–447 and 851–852 address Makai and receive replies on 14590105. The owner verified both questions and corrected the name to Makai. This is a single-day association.

entries.name: Dustin K. Manis
entries.note: Owner-confirmed on October 4 only. Clip 16 says Manis? (verified) and clip 17 replies Yeah on 14590314. Clip 15 says Somerville, Manis is here now. (verified); clips 25–26 also contain Bye Dustin after this ID transmits. September 11 clips 1–2 (possibly Maynes) and October 3 clips 62–63 (Mayness / Manus?) are tentative earlier matches, pending listening review.

entries.name: Mckay A. Valadez
entries.note: McKay and Makai are different names. They should not be combined because of a transcript spelling.

entries.name: Jonathan Wagley
entries.note: Other IDs have single-day or conflicting examples; consult the spreadsheet before using them.

entries.name: Sammantha J. Halladay
entries.note: Owner listening identification, October 27, 2026: October 7 clips 54–55 address Sam and receive a female-voiced reply on 14590067; October 8 clips 13–14 address [Sam / Sammy] and receive a reply on the same ID. September 24 clips 80–81 and 85–86 address Sam and receive replies on 14590100; the owner hears a female voice matching Halladay. These are owner voice observations; the full exchange transcripts are not marked verified. Sam also refers to Samuel Canizalez, whose observed ID is 14590090.

entries.name: Samuel Canizalez
entries.note: Owner listening identification, October 27, 2026. September 28 clips 119–121 and 171–172 address Sam and receive replies on 14590090. The full exchange transcripts are not marked verified. Keep separate from Sammantha J. Halladay's 14590067 and 14590100. The owner also identifies Sam on 14590066 (September 28 clips 191–192) and 14590268 (October 7 clips 39–40) as Samuel Canizalez.

entries.name: Tanner M. Ballamis
entries.note: Owner identifies Tanner, T-Ball and G-Ball as Tanner Ballamis. Ten named response pairs on September 19, October 3, October 21 and October 22 use 14580151. The October 22 clip 109 name was corrected to T-Ball after owner listening. G-Ball is retained as a heard variation. The identification does not verify every word in those clips or every transmission under this ID.

officers.unresolved: First-name or nickname references without a clear officer match are not listed. The spreadsheet retains those unresolved examples for further review.

entities.idExplanation: The numeric radio ID beside a clip identifies a transmitting radio. A spoken call sign identifies a unit or agency; a talkgroup identifies the conversation channel.
